import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; import { CheckSquare, Target, Calendar, TrendingUp, BookOpen, Plus, Clock, ArrowRight, Zap, Star, Award, Users } from 'lucide-react'; const quickActions = [ { title: 'Add New Task', icon: , link: '/tasks', color: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 border-blue-100', description: 'Create a new task', image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1484480974693-6ca0a78fb36b?w=300&h=200&fit=crop&crop=center' }, { title: 'Set New Goal', icon: , link: '/goals', color: 'bg-green-50 text-green-600 border-green-100', description: 'Define your milestone', image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551836022-deb4988cc6c0?w=300&h=200&fit=crop&crop=center' }, { title: 'View Calendar', icon: , link: '/calendar', color: 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 border-purple-100', description: 'Check your schedule', image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1506905925346-21bda4d32df4?w=300&h=200&fit=crop&crop=center' }, { title: 'Write Journal', icon: , link: '/diary', color: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border-orange-100', description: 'Capture your thoughts', image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1455390582262-044cdead277a?w=300&h=200&fit=crop&crop=center' } ]; const statCards = [ { title: 'Total Tasks', value: stats.tasks.total, icon: , color: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 border-blue-100', change: '+12%', changeColor: 'text-green-600', bgGradient: 'from-blue-100 to-blue-200' }, { title: 'Completed Today', value: stats.tasks.completed, icon: , color: 'bg-green-50 text-green-600 border-green-100', change: '+8%', changeColor: 'text-green-600', bgGradient: 'from-green-100 to-green-200' }, { title: 'Active Goals', value: stats.goals.total - stats.goals.completed, icon: , color: 'bg-purple-50 text-purple-600 border-purple-100', change: '+3%', changeColor: 'text-green-600', bgGradient: 'from-purple-100 to-purple-200' }, { title: 'Success Rate', value: `${Math.round((stats.tasks.completed / stats.tasks.total) * 100)}%`, icon: , color: 'bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 border-orange-100', change: '+15%', changeColor: 'text-green-600', bgGradient: 'from-orange-100 to-orange-200' } ];
